mapper.sql: id, project_id, batch_code, batch_root_marker, logistics_no, arrived_at, signer_snapshot, status, project_version, project_participant_fact_version, project_scope_version, delivery_scope_version, expected_scope_snapshot, scope_watermark, migration_resolution_status, migration_reason_code, legacy_source_id, project_fact_version, evidence_id, evidence_revision, predecessor_acceptance_id, successor_reason, submitted_by, submitted_at, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id
mapper.update: UPDATE imp_arrival_acceptance SET status = #{query.submittedStatus}, evidence_id = #{query.evidenceId}, evidence_revision = #{query.evidenceRevision}, submitted_by = #{query.submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{query.submittedAt}, version = version + 1, updater = CAST(#{query.submittedBy} AS CHAR), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.arrivalAcceptanceId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE imp_arrival_acceptance SET status = 'CONFIRMED', project_fact_version = #{query.projectFactVersion}, confirmed_by = #{query.confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = #{query.confirmedAt}, version = version + 1, updater = CAST(#{query.confirmedBy} AS CHAR), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.arrivalAcceptanceId} AND status IN ('PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED', 'ACCEPTED') AND project_fact_version IS NULL AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE imp_arrival_acceptance SET logistics_no = #{query.logisticsNo}, arrived_at = #{query.arrivedAt}, signer_snapshot = #{query.signerSnapshot}, version = version + 1, updater = CAST(#{query.actorUserId} AS CHAR), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.arrivalAcceptanceId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND creator = CAST(#{query.actorUserId} AS CHAR) AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM imp_arrival_acceptance WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY project_fact_version, id
SELECT FROM imp_arrival_acceptance WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT allocated.project_fact_version, allocated.source_type, allocated.source_id, allocated.acceptance_id, allocated.predecessor_acceptance_id FROM ( SELECT a.project_fact_version, 'ACCEPTANCE' AS source_type, a.id AS source_id, a.id AS acceptance_id, a.predecessor_acceptance_id FROM imp_arrival_acceptance a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND a.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT d.project_fact_version, 'DIFFERENCE' AS source_type, d.id AS source_id, d.arrival_acceptance_id AS acceptance_id, a.predecessor_acceptance_id FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND d.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted = b'0' ) allocated ORDER BY allocated.project_fact_version DESC, allocated.source_type, allocated.source_id LIMIT 2

SELECT a.project_fact_version, 'ACCEPTANCE' AS source_type, a.id AS source_id, a.id AS acceptance_id, a.predecessor_acceptance_id FROM imp_arrival_acceptance a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND a.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY a.project_fact_version DESC, a.id LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE

SELECT MAX(allocated.project_fact_version) FROM ( SELECT a.project_fact_version FROM imp_arrival_acceptance a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND a.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT d.project_fact_version FROM imp_arrival_difference d JOIN imp_arrival_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.id = d.arrival_acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND d.project_fact_version IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted = b'0' ) allocated
SELECT FROM imp_arrival_acceptance WHERE ORDER BY arrived_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.limit}
